name: redshift-dbt-guard
description: Blocks destructive SQL and dbt writes against prod Redshift Serverless, shows the live target, toasts long dbt runs

prodDatabases.title: Prod databases
prodDatabases.description: Comma-separated database names treated as prod, for dbt targets and for SQL sent through aws redshift-data or psql

prodDbtTarget.title: Prod dbt target
prodDbtTarget.description: dbt target name treated as prod

toastSeconds.title: Toast after (seconds)
toastSeconds.description: Toast when a dbt run, build or test takes at least this long
